resources.string: Free here
If you have just installed this app and do not know us, this page is the shortest way to see what you get. Everything below it is something another product charges for.
The prices below were read from each product\'s own page on %1$s and may have changed since.
Of the %1$s things we checked, %2$s are free here, %3$s are partial, and %4$s we do not have at all.
What we do not have

This section is here on purpose. If every line in this list said we had it, the first reader who had actually used one of these products would find the overstatement within a minute — and after that no other line would be believed either.
Free
Partial
Not here
There is no monthly subscription, no in-app purchase and no advertising in this app.
Indicators per chart — 2 on the free tier
From $12.95 to $199.95 a month
%1$s indicators, %2$s drawing tools and %3$s chart types, with no cap on how many you put on at once.
Price alerts — 3 on the free tier
%1$s alerts, on the phone itself. The cap exists only so a bug in the app cannot write rows forever.
Watchlists — 1 on the free tier · Saved layouts — 1
%1$s watchlists with colour flags and chosen columns, and %2$s saved layouts.
Charts per tab — 1 on the free tier
Two. Ahead of their free tier and level with their middle plan, but not the eight their most expensive one gives.
Volume profile
We do not have it, and it cannot be built without intraday volume. Neither of our two feeds sends any.
Ad removal
From about $8.32 a month billed yearly
This app has no advertising at all, so there is nothing to remove.
On-chain wallet tracking
We do not have it. It needs an on-chain data provider, and we relay two exchanges.
Market cap, circulating supply and global rank
From $29 a month

We do not have these. They come from an aggregator rather than an exchange, and we have no aggregator — which is why the heat map has no size-by-market-cap mode at all, rather than a button that cannot answer.
On-chain metrics — exchange flows, SOPR, MVRV
From about $49 a month to near $999
We do not have these and we are not promising them. Their whole product is on-chain and we have no source for it.
Advanced screener
About $29 a month
Our screener is free and can filter on the indicators themselves.
Portfolio analytics — Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
About $8.33 a month billed yearly
Sharpe, Sortino, profit factor, expectancy, maximum drawdown, the equity curve, per-symbol attribution and CSV export — all free.
AI assistant and custom alerts
From about $9.50 a month
The assistant, signal generation and chart-image analysis are all here and all free.
Fair value from 17 valuation models
We do not have it, and for crypto it has no meaning: those models work on a company\'s financial statements. Not building it is a decision, not a gap.
Candle history — 5,000 bars on the free tier

Ours is shorter, and this is the one row where their free tier beats us: about 1,900 bars, which on the daily is 3.7 years against roughly 13. The limit is the venue\'s retention window, not a decision of ours.
